column1: # Final timing protocol, galaxy (2026-10-17): Ampere Altra 128 cores, every pipeline pinned to cores 0-63 (taskset), one NVIDIA A100 (device 1) for the certa-gpu rows.
# 20,001,073 HG002 reads (single-end, R1) or pairs; SAM to /dev/null; one session; single-end: three rounds, tools in turn; paired: one run each. Build: commit 80646c3.

# certa-cpu / certa-gpu: CERTA streams its uncertified reads into minibwa, both concurrent (config = CERTA:minibwa threads; single-end minibwa -K 10m; paired: minibwa's default batch (Kdefault) or -K 10m).
# certa-*-iv: interval mode (--intervals), no fallback. certa-*-tier: certified reads only, not a complete mapping. Script: final_bench.sh (galaxy:~/certa-bench/cpu/).
